items.title: Setting breakpoints in IDEs like PyCharm or VS Code (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Setting breakpoints in IDEs like PyCharm or VS Code (PDF 66, printed 62), paragraph for paragraph with the English; Code Explanation boxes and runnable examples added 2026-10-29.

blocks.text: Breakpoint aik nishan (marker) hai jo program ko chuni hui line par rok deta hai. PyCharm aur VS Code jaise IDEs (code likhne aur chalane ke programs) mein breakpoint sirf aik click se lagta hai. Program breakpoint par pohanch kar ruk jata hai, aur us waqt ki halat (current state) dekhi ja sakti hai. Breakpoints se poora program chalaye baghair code ke khaas hisse par tawajjo di ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: VS Code mein bhi breakpoint line number ke baayein haashiye (margin) par click se lagta hai aur laal nuqta ban jata hai. Phir program Debug (F5) se chalayein, Run se nahi; tabhi woh breakpoint par rukta hai.

items: Breakpoint: line par laga nishan jahan program ruk jata hai.
Ruk kar program ki us waqt ki halat dekhi jati hai.
